description: Milestone 5 research study registry and protocol definition metadata

governance_rules.immutability_rule: Protocols are immutable once research sessions have been recorded. Updating study protocol version is blocked if sessions exist under that version.

scientific_disclaimer: RESEARCH PROTOTYPE NOTICE: VoxNeuro is an investigational software platform for speech acoustics research. It does NOT provide clinical diagnostic decisions, rule-out determinations, or diagnostic disease probabilities. All metrics are descriptive and exploratory.
